seo.title: Privacy and Cookie Policy | SolPrompter
seo.description: Learn how SolPrompter collects, uses, stores and protects account data, scripts, recordings, camera and microphone information, cookies and payment data.

content.html:
Effective date: July 17, 2026
Last updated: July 17, 2026
This Privacy and Cookie Policy explains how SolPrompter collects, uses, stores, shares and protects personal data when you use:

items: Related products, features and support services.

content.html: In this Policy, “SolPrompter,” “we,” “us” and “our” refer to the person or entity operating SolPrompter from Vietnam.
For personal data processed in connection with SolPrompter, the data controller is:

SolPrompter
Website: https://solprompter.com
Email: contact.solplatform@gmail.com
Country of operation: Vietnam
Where a third-party provider independently determines how it processes information, that provider may act as a separate controller under its own privacy policy.
This Policy applies to personal data processed through the Service.
It does not apply to:

items: Third-party websites not controlled by SolPrompter.
Services that you access through external links.
Data processed independently by payment providers, app stores or authentication providers.
Information processed solely by your device or browser without being transmitted to SolPrompter.

content.html: The information collected depends on the features you use.
3.1 Account information
When you create or manage an account, we may collect:
If you use a third-party login provider, we receive only the information that provider makes available based on your settings and permissions.
3.2 Scripts, files and recordings
When you use content features, we may process:

items: Uploaded TXT, DOCX, PDF, Markdown or other supported files.

content.html: Depending on the feature and technical configuration, processing may occur:

items: Through a contracted cloud or AI service provider.

content.html: The fact that a feature can operate locally does not mean every SolPrompter feature operates locally. The interface or permission notice may provide additional information for particular features.
3.3 Camera and microphone data
When you enable camera, recording or AI Voice Scroll features, the Service may access:
Camera and microphone access requires permission from your browser, device or operating system.
We process this data to provide the feature you request. We do not use camera or microphone access to activate recording when you have not initiated or authorized the relevant feature.
SolPrompter is not designed to identify users through biometric recognition.
3.4 Device and technical information
We may automatically collect:
3.5 Usage information
We may collect information about how the Service is used, including:
Where practical, analytics information may be aggregated or pseudonymized.
3.6 Payment and billing information
When paid services are available, we may collect:

items: Partial payment-method details, such as card brand and last four digits.

content.html: Payments may be processed by third-party payment providers.

SolPrompter generally does not receive or store full payment card numbers, card security codes or banking credentials when those details are entered directly into a payment provider’s secure interface.
3.7 Communications
When you contact us, we may collect:
3.8 Information from third parties
We may receive information from:

items: Other users who invite you to a shared session.

content.html: We may use personal data to:

items: Provide remote control and cross-device functionality.
Detect fraud, abuse and unauthorized access.
Protect users, SolPrompter and third parties.

content.html: We will not use scripts or private recordings for unrelated advertising.
We will not use private User Content to train a general-purpose AI model unless we separately disclose that practice and obtain any consent required by applicable law.
Where applicable law requires a legal basis, we process personal data based on one or more of the following:
Contract. Processing necessary to provide the Service you request, including account access, script storage, recording, subscriptions and support.
Consent. Processing based on your permission, such as:

items: Other optional processing where consent is required.

content.html: You may withdraw consent at any time. Withdrawal does not affect processing lawfully performed before withdrawal.
Legitimate interests. Processing reasonably necessary for:
We balance these interests against your rights and expectations.
Legal obligation. Processing required for:
Protection of vital interests. Processing necessary in rare circumstances to protect a person’s life or physical safety.
We may share information with the following categories of recipients.
6.1 Service providers
Providers that help us operate SolPrompter, including:
These providers may process data only for contracted purposes, subject to applicable agreements and legal requirements.
6.2 App stores and payment platforms
Purchases made through Apple, Google or another marketplace may be processed and administered by that platform.
The platform may independently process payment, account, subscription and refund information.
6.3 Legal and safety disclosures
We may disclose information when reasonably necessary to:

items: Comply with law or valid legal process.
Protect the rights, safety or property of users, SolPrompter or others.
Establish, exercise or defend legal claims.

content.html: We may challenge requests that we reasonably believe are invalid, excessive or unlawful.
6.4 Business transactions
If SolPrompter is involved in a merger, acquisition, financing, restructuring, bankruptcy or sale of assets, personal data may be transferred as part of that transaction.
The recipient will be required to handle the information in accordance with applicable law and any commitments that continue to apply.
6.5 With your direction
We may share information when you:
SolPrompter does not currently display third-party advertising within the core Service.
We do not intend to sell personal data for money.

Some privacy laws may define “sale,” “sharing” or “targeted advertising” broadly. If SolPrompter introduces a practice that falls within those definitions, we will provide any notice, consent mechanism or opt-out required by applicable law.
We retain personal data only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this Policy.
Retention depends on:

items: Whether you store scripts or recordings.

content.html: Examples include:

items: Account data may be retained while your account is active.
User Content may be retained until you delete it or close your account.
Deleted data may remain temporarily in restricted backups.
Billing records may be retained for legally required accounting periods.
Security logs may be retained for a limited period to detect abuse.
Support communications may be retained while reasonably needed to resolve issues and maintain records.

content.html: We may retain anonymized or aggregated information that no longer identifies you.
You may delete individual scripts or recordings through available controls.
You may request account deletion by contacting: contact.solplatform@gmail.com
Before processing a deletion request, we may verify your identity.
Deletion may not immediately remove information from:

items: Information needed to resolve a dispute.

content.html: When retention is legally required, we will restrict further use to the required purpose.
SolPrompter operates from Vietnam and may use service providers located in other countries.
As a result, personal data may be processed in countries whose privacy laws differ from those where you live.
Where required, we use appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers, which may include:

items: Consent where legally permitted and required.

content.html: Depending on your location and applicable law, you may have the right to:

items: Request confirmation that we process your personal data.
Receive a copy of certain data.
Opt out of certain sale, sharing or targeted advertising.
Limit certain uses of sensitive personal data.
Appeal a denied request where applicable.
Complain to a competent data-protection authority.
Receive equal service without unlawful discrimination for exercising privacy rights.

content.html: These rights may be subject to legal exceptions.
To submit a request, contact: contact.solplatform@gmail.com
Your request should identify:

items: The right you wish to exercise.
The relevant data or processing activity.
Any information reasonably needed to verify your identity.

content.html: We will respond within the period required by applicable law.
We may decline or limit a request when legally permitted, including where we cannot verify identity, the request is manifestly unfounded or the information must be retained by law.
This section applies only where California privacy law applies to SolPrompter.
California residents may have rights to:

items: Know the categories and specific pieces of personal information collected.
Know the sources and purposes of collection.
Opt out of sale or sharing.
Limit certain uses of sensitive personal information.

content.html: SolPrompter does not currently intend to sell personal information for money.
Where legally required, we will recognize applicable opt-out preference signals and provide an appropriate request method.
Authorized agents may submit requests where permitted by law, subject to verification.

content.text: 13. European and United Kingdom Privacy Rights

content.html: Where the GDPR or United Kingdom data-protection law applies, you may have rights of:
Where processing is based on legitimate interests, you may object based on your particular situation.
Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent at any time.
Where Vietnamese personal-data law applies, you may exercise the rights available to data subjects under applicable law, which may include rights relating to:
Certain rights may be limited where processing is required or permitted by law.
SolPrompter is not directed to children under 13.
We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13 without legally required parental permission.
If you believe a child has provided personal data without appropriate permission, contact: contact.solplatform@gmail.com
We will investigate and take appropriate deletion or restriction measures.
Users between 13 and the age of legal majority should use SolPrompter with parental or guardian involvement where required.
We use reasonable technical and organizational safeguards designed to protect personal data.
Measures may include:
No internet service or storage system is completely secure.
You are responsible for protecting your account, device and exported files.
If we identify a personal-data breach requiring notification, we will notify affected users and authorities as required by applicable law.
SolPrompter may use cookies, local storage, software development kits and similar technologies.
Essential technologies
These technologies may be necessary to:
Essential technologies may operate without optional consent where legally permitted.
Preference technologies
These may remember:
Analytics technologies
With consent where required, analytics technologies may help us understand:
We use this information to improve the Service.
Advertising technologies
SolPrompter does not currently use third-party advertising cookies within the core Service.
If advertising or cross-site marketing technologies are introduced, we will update this Policy and provide required controls.
Managing cookies
You may manage cookies through:

items: The SolPrompter cookie banner or privacy settings, where available.

content.html: Blocking essential cookies may prevent account login, preferences or other features from working correctly.
Withdrawing optional cookie consent does not affect processing performed before withdrawal.

content.text: 18. Do Not Track and Opt-Out Signals

content.html: Browser “Do Not Track” signals are not implemented consistently across the internet.

Where applicable law requires recognition of a legally valid opt-out preference signal, and where SolPrompter is technically able to detect it, we will treat the signal in accordance with applicable requirements.
The Service may link to third-party websites.
SolPrompter does not control those sites and is not responsible for their privacy practices.
Review the privacy policy of any third-party service before providing personal data.
We may update this Policy to reflect:
We will update the “Last updated” date.
For material changes, we may provide additional notice through the Service, email or another reasonable method.
Where consent is required for a new processing purpose, we will request consent before beginning that processing.
Privacy questions and requests may be sent to:

SolPrompter
Website: https://solprompter.com
Email: contact.solplatform@gmail.com
Country of operation: Vietnam
